items.title: Carolyn Buck Interview, 1969-03-25
items.q: Mrs. Tate flew in from California. She wrote the book, Call on George, Dorothy Tate. He had very few visitors simply because he had been so ill that we weren't allowing many visitors.

ctx.x: Can you remember some of the other people that came to see him at that time in the hospital?

Well, Mrs. Tate flew in from California. She wrote the book, Call on George, Dorothy Tate. He had very few visitors simply because he had been so ill that we weren't allowing many visitors. Bill Russell came to see him quite frequently, bless yourself.
Did George say anything about Bill Russell?
